title: EPIC 01: Define service taxonomy and product boundaries

title: Define record-level access and team/branch boundaries

acceptance_criteria: Specify principal/service/device identity, issuer+subject uniqueness and approved tenant membership.

title: Initialize pnpm/Turborepo monorepo and CI
acceptance_criteria: Create all four apps and shared packages, pin supported versions and lockfile, validate env and repeatable local startup.
Clean checkout installs and typechecks/builds; CI has least permissions and no secret leakage; failure states are actionable.

title: Implement organization/tenant boundary and auth foundation
acceptance_criteria: Implement approved memberships, verified OIDC/session boundary and tenant-scoped persistence.

title: Implement RBAC/record authorization middleware
acceptance_criteria: Implement one shared default-deny RBAC/ABAC policy and consistent API/worker/storage authorization.

title: Implement audit event service and sensitive-field redaction
acceptance_criteria: Write redacted actor/purpose/resource/correlation audit atomically with important mutations.

verification: Issue/PR/commit links plus direct test/design/document evidence required; not executed.

title: Implement encrypted object storage and malware/file validation
acceptance_criteria: Implement encrypted versioned object abstraction, quarantine, file validation and scan states with fail-closed access.

title: Implement secrets management, dependency scanning and security CI
acceptance_criteria: Validate secrets-store references and run dependency/secret scans with supported pinned versions.

title: Implement backup/restore procedure and test
acceptance_criteria: Specify approved RPO/RTO, encrypted backups, restore role and migration/forward-repair runbook.
